title: ADR-0087 gate: a whole-package `#*` operand passes when a metadata surface names the package only inside a path or URL string
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966, `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`), holding #26220 as #26365's blocker. Source: the director's contract review PASS on PR #26766 (comment 6458009682, ①-1 and ③-(a)), which graded this residual should-fix and not blocking. It stayed off that PR so the PASS kept its head. ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage. Parent: #26220 (merged as `4bce21da81`).

## Symptom

`packageReference` in `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (≈L4816 on `main`) reads predicate 2 for a `<package>#*` operand. Its mention regex is `(?<![\w@./-])${name}(?![\w.-])`. The lookbehind excludes a preceding `/`, so an occurrence glued to a path or URL inside a string is not read:

- `'…/node_modules/@object-ui/plugin-x/dist/index.js'`
- `'https://npm.im/@object-ui/plugin-x'`

The ADR text (D9, second 2026-10-27 note, predicate 2) says "any other occurrence of the package name, a string value included", so the gate admits what the text refuses. This is the admit direction, but the director measured it as marginal: the realistic shapes (an import, a value string, a version spec `pkg@1.0.0`) are all refused and pinned (WP-R10, WP-R14, WP-U5).

## Expected

A path- or URL-embedded occurrence of the package name in a non-comment string counts as a `mention`, with one new WP U-case pinning it. The existing greens stay green: WP-G3 (comment only) and WP-U4 (`plugin-xy` is not `plugin-x`).

⚠️ The director's fix sketch ("drop `/` from the lookbehind") is not a one-character change for an UNSCOPED name. With `/` admitted, `plugin-x` would match inside `@scope/plugin-x`, which is another package. The fix has to keep a scope segment from counting as a preceding path. One way is to admit `/` only when what precedes it is not `@scope`. The implementer measures this and pins both directions.

## Filing facts

- Business reason: the gate's accept set should equal the ADR's text. This is the only known gap between them for the new operand.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (domain, area, level), then the implementer for `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`. The file is governed only by the ADR it enforces (`scripts/**` is not Tier H). A change to the accept set owes a contract review per the D9 precedent.
- Dedupe: every open issue on this repo (5 REST pages, newest 500) grepped for `0087` together with `package`, `#*`, `mention` or `lookbehind`: no card covers this gap. The two hits are a `default`-export disposition card and a tracking line for #26365.
